evidence_snippets: You can do this using the Google Cloud CLI or the Google Cloud console. gcloud Run the following command: gcloud container clusters create-auto CLUSTER NAME \ --location = CONTROL PLANE LOCATION \ --create-subnetwork = name = SUBNET NAME \ --enable-master-authorized-networks \ --enable-private-nodes \ --enable-private-endpoint Replace the following: CLUSTER NAME : the name of the new cluster.

To initialize the gcloud CLI, run the following command: gcloud init After initializing the gcloud CLI, update it and install the required components: gcloud components update gcloud components install alpha beta Create a private cluster Create a new private cluster with no client access to the public endpoint.
